summary: TORM plc furnished a Form 6-K attaching its Q3 2026 interim results press release and report for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026. No transaction, stake, price or premium is stated. Q3 TCE earnings were USD 353m versus USD 236m, EBITDA USD 274m, net profit USD 199m, fleet TCE USD 40,102/day, and a USD 1.35 quarterly dividend (75% payout). Disclosed were the sales of the 2007-built LR1 TORM Venture and the 2008-built MR vessel; these are routine fleet-renewal disposals, not a special situation. Watch dividend sustainability and vessel-sale proceeds.
